## LOAD PACKAGES

```{r, results='hide', message=FALSE}

library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(writexl)
library(flextable)
library(purrr)

```

```{r, warning=FALSE}

## Prior EWAS 
#Maternal educational attainment in pregnancy and epigenome-wide DNA methylation changes in the offspring from birth until adolescence (PMID: 38052982)
maternal_educ_ewas <- readxl::read_xlsx("Manuscript/EWAS_Overlap/PMID-38052982-ewas-maternaleducation.xlsx")

#Epigenetic signatures of cigarette smoking (PMID: 27651444)

currentsmk_ewas <-  readxl::read_xlsx("Manuscript/EWAS_Overlap/PMC5267325_meta-ewas_currentcigarettesmoking.xlsx")

#Epigenetic signatures of cigarette smoking (PMID: 27651444)
  ## Former vs Never Smokers
formersmk_ewas <-  readxl::read_xlsx("Manuscript/EWAS_Overlap/PMC5267325_meta-ewas_formercigarettesmoking.xlsx")

```

## COMPARE SITES WITHIN OUR STUDY

```{r}

#CHILD RURAL OVERLAP
overlap_rural <- Reduce(intersect, list(rural_smk_8$CpG, sh_rural$CpG, h_rural$CpG))

combined_rural <- data.frame(
  CpG = overlap_rural,
  chr = rural_smk_8 %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_rural) %>% pull(CHR),
  pos = rural_smk_8 %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_rural) %>% pull(BP),
  gene = rural_smk_8 %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_rural) %>% pull(UCSC_RefGene_Name),
  rural_smk_8.estimate = rural_smk_8 %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_rural) %>% pull(logFC),
  rural_smk_8.pval = rural_smk_8 %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_rural) %>% pull(P.Value),
  sh_rural.estimate = sh_rural %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_rural) %>% pull(logFC),
  sh_rural.pval = sh_rural %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_rural) %>% pull(P.Value),
  h_rural.estimate = h_rural %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_rural) %>% pull(logFC),
  h_rural.pval = h_rural %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_rural) %>% pull(P.Value)
)

combined_rural$gene <- gsub(";.*", "", combined_rural$gene)
write_xlsx(combined_rural, "Manuscript/EWAS_Overlap/ALL Child Rural Models CpG Overlap.xlsx", format_headers = TRUE)
```

## COMPARE SITES WITH PRIOR LITERATURE

### Years in School

```{r}
#SCHLYRS OVERLAP
overlap_schlyrs_maternalea <- Reduce(intersect, list(maternal_educ_ewas$CpG, schlyrs_m3$CpG))
combined_schlyrs2 <- data.frame(
  CpG = overlap_schlyrs_maternalea,
  chr = schlyrs_m3 %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_schlyrs_maternalea) %>% pull(CHR),
  pos = schlyrs_m3 %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_schlyrs_maternalea) %>% pull(BP),
  gene = schlyrs_m3 %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_schlyrs_maternalea) %>% pull(UCSC_RefGene_Name),
  schlyrs_m3.estimate = schlyrs_m3 %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_schlyrs_maternalea) %>% pull(logFC),
  schlyrs_m3.pval = schlyrs_m3 %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_schlyrs_maternalea) %>% pull(P.Value),
  maternal_educ_ewas.estimate = maternal_educ_ewas %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_schlyrs_maternalea) %>% pull(logFC),
  maternal_educ_ewas.pval = maternal_educ_ewas %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_schlyrs_maternalea) %>% pull(P.Value)
)
combined_schlyrs2$gene <- gsub(";.*", "", combined_schlyrs2$gene)

# Get top shared significant site (p< 0.05)
sig_hitss2 <- combined_schlyrs2 %>%  filter(maternal_educ_ewas.pval < 0.05 & schlyrs_m3.pval < 0.05)

sheets = list('All Overlap' = combined_schlyrs2, 'P<0.05' = sig_hitss2)
writexl::write_xlsx(sheets, 'Manuscript/EWAS_Overlap/M3 Years in School Overlap maternal ea.xlsx', format_headers = TRUE)

```

###Child Smoking

```{r}
#CHILD SMOKING OVERLAP
```
